text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Sounds of Earth, 
who wasn't feeling well. We immediately 
prayed for his recovery.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That should do it... Let us hope it 
modulates into a major key.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Oh? Is that... singing?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A sad, poignant melody that permeates the 
very soul...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pietoso... Even singing a cappella, your 
voice sounds a bit clouded.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Can't you hear it coming from the forest? 
Let's just go and check it out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Sounds of Earth, I found a 
small, dilapidated shrine. The Jizo statue 
inside was covered in thick moss.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So it was you who was singing that elegy. 
It's no wonder, getting this dirty.
choice_data_list: (Seems like only Earth can hear it.)
(Looks like only Earth can hear it.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we dance a little 
waltz of cleaning?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I just happen to have a brush with me. 
...Though it's meant for combing tails, 
mind you.
choice_data_list:
Won't you end up completely useless if you 
keep that up?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of replacements out 
there. More importantly, this encounter is 
far more precious, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's fix up our appearance and clear up 
this gloomy Melodia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brush carefully, as if sounding 
harmonics... lightly. So as not to hurt... 
mezzo-piano.
choice_data_list:
You have such a gentle touch with the 
brush, huh.

You have such a gentle touch with the 
brush, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I've always been very particular about 
grooming my ears and tail, after all."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I did plenty of research to groom my coat 
into a smooth legato.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo! Hasn't it become quite 
pristine?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Sounds of Earth placed a 
small floral ornament onto the head of the 
Jizo statue in the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just a little touch of fashion! A 
small accent can make quite a difference, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, even the lamentabile has turned into 
a beautiful cantabile!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, a breeze blew through, rustling the 
leaves. The sound carried a gentle, 
soothing warmth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, shall we head back to the 
shrine?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ! Bellissimo! Just take a look!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd get to see a rainbow with 
you. I'm sure good things are in store for 
us ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it the blessing of cleaning? Sounds of 
Earth regained his form after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, the sky that had just been 
clear turned dark, and raindrops began to 
patter down.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Doloroso... The weather has taken a turn 
for the worse.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame, but fine—shall we leave the 
cleaning for our next visit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's shoulders dropped as she 
said that. She wasn't able to get back in 
top form.
